headline: Microsoft puts Brad Smith in charge of communications
summary: Microsoft is moving its communications group under Brad Smith. The change shifts the department into CELA, out of marketing. A search is underway for a new chief communications officer.

headline: Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar gives Google's AI a face
summary: Google's new Gemini 3.8 Live features a "Live Avatar" for real-time AI conversations. The avatar can lip-sync and display various facial expressions. This feature is currently only available to Gemini Enterprise customers.

headline: Sadly, this $1,549 RTX 5070-equipped gaming PC is a very good deal
summary: A CyberPowerPC gaming PC with an RTX 5070 is on sale for $1,549 at Walmart. The prebuilt desktop offers nearly $600 in savings off its original price. It includes an Intel Core i7-14700KF processor and 32GB of 6000MHz RAM.

headline: Jensen Huang talks about AI and climate change like a supervillain
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang discussed AI's role in combating climate change. He stated AI must first inflict "an enormous amount of pain and suffering." Huang's comments on energy and AI sparked debate.

headline: The Gigabyte A16 Pro 16" RTX 5070 Ti Gaming Laptop Drops to $1,449 During Walmart's GeForce Week Sale
summary: The Gigabyte A16 Pro 16" RTX 5070 Ti gaming laptop is now priced at $1,449. This deal is part of Walmart's special GeForce Week Sale. It promises strong gaming performance in a slim and lightweight design.

headline: Arc Raiders Is Testing a PvE Mode Very Soon
summary: Embark Studios announced upcoming testing for Arc Raiders. The game will soon introduce a new PvE mode. Player tests are scheduled to begin next month.

headline: Ubisoft Almost Made a Zelda Game With Ganondorf as the Protagonist
summary: Ubisoft Milan reportedly pitched a unique Zelda game to Nintendo. The concept would feature Ganondorf as the protagonist in a new universe. The ambitious project ultimately did not come to fruition.

headline: Target Confirms Jack Skellington's Real-Life Height in a New Halloween Sale Listing
summary: Target revealed the "real-life" height of Jack Skellington. The detail appeared in a new Halloween sale product listing. This fun fact is generating buzz among fans.

headline: Watch: Why has Trump been so eager to welcome Xi?
summary: President Donald Trump has shown strong anticipation for Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit. The BBC's Sarah Smith explores the motivations behind Trump's eagerness. This video examines the political implications of the upcoming meeting.

headline: Anti-migrant activist charged after dinghy slashed in Channel
summary: Activist Daniel Thomas has been charged in connection with an incident. He is accused of slashing a dinghy in the English Channel. The event occurred on Tuesday, leading to his arrest.

headline: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order
summary: The White House has restored access for several media outlets. These outlets were previously banned during the Trump administration. This decision follows a judge's recent order.

headline: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
summary: Benjamin Netanyahu defended Israeli military actions at the UN General Assembly. Several delegates staged a walkout during his address. Netanyahu criticized those who left, calling them "moral cowards."
